description: Source code for the ActivityMonitor plugin in the WPEFramework, implementing memory and CPU monitoring, process info gathering, and event notifications.

classes.name: AppConfig
classes.description: Configuration for individual applications being monitored, including thresholds and state.

classes.name: MonitorParams
classes.description: Parameters for monitoring intervals, process list, and CPU usage tracking.

classes.name: MemoryInfo
classes.description: Utility class providing system memory and process information, including CPU usage, memory stats, and process details.

classes.name: ActivityMonitor
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing memory and CPU monitoring, process info collection, and event notification logic.

methods.name: getApplicationMemoryUsage
methods.description: Retrieves memory usage for a specific application process by PID.

methods.name: getAllMemoryUsage
methods.description: Retrieves memory usage for all monitored applications.

methods.name: enableMonitoring
methods.description: Starts monitoring specified applications with configured thresholds and intervals.

methods.name: monitoring
methods.description: Main loop performing periodic memory and CPU checks, and triggering threshold events.

methods.name: onMemoryThresholdOccurred
methods.description: Notifies when memory threshold events occur.

methods.name: onCPUThresholdOccurred
methods.description: Notifies when CPU threshold events occur.
